subject: Charged twice
body: Hi, my card was charged twice for the Pro plan yesterday, 29 USD each time. Can you refund the duplicate payment?

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled my subscription last week but was charged 19 USD three days ago. Please refund it.

subject: Refund for last year
body: Hello, I would like a refund of the 120 USD I paid for the annual plan last year. I never used it.

subject: Need the March invoice
body: Where can I download the invoice for March? Our accountant needs it.

subject: Downgrade question
body: If I move from Team to Pro, when does the lower price start?

subject: Please refund my annual plan
body: I bought the annual plan 5 days ago (480 USD) and we decided not to go ahead. Please refund the full amount.

subject: Forgot my password
body: I forgot my password and cannot sign in. Can you help me get back in?

subject: Reset email never arrived
body: I asked for a password reset twice but nothing arrives. Please send another.

subject: New phone, how do I move 2FA?
body: I got a new phone. I still have my recovery codes. How do I set up two-factor authentication again?

subject: Lost my phone, no codes
body: I lost my phone and I do not have my recovery codes. Please turn off two-factor on my account so I can log in.

subject: Change my login email
body: I left my old company. Please change the login email of my account to my new address, sam.new@example.org.

subject: Blank page after login
body: After I sign in the dashboard is a white page. Happens on Firefox, Chrome is fine.

subject: Export button does nothing
body: I click Export on the reports page and nothing happens. No error either.

subject: 500 on POST /v1/jobs
body: Since this morning my POST /v1/jobs calls return 500. Other endpoints work. Only my key seems affected.

subject: Wrong example in the docs
body: The curl example on the webhooks page has a typo in the header name. It should be X-Signature.

subject: Dark mode please
body: Would be great if the dashboard had a dark mode. My eyes hurt at night.

subject: Rotating an API key
body: How do I rotate the API key for our production service without downtime?

subject: Where do I create an API key
body: I cannot find where to create a new API key.

subject: Custom domain setup
body: How can I use app.ourcompany.com instead of the default address?

subject: Custom domain not verifying
body: I added the CNAME an hour ago but verification still fails. What should I check?

subject: Export all our data
body: How do I export all workspace data as CSV?

subject: How do I cancel
body: Where do I cancel our subscription?

subject: Everything is down
body: All requests return 502 in every region since 9am. This is hurting our customers.

subject: Dashboard unavailable for our whole team
body: Nobody on our team in Europe can open the dashboard. It times out.

subject: Is there an outage?
body: My jobs keep failing and a colleague at another company says theirs do too. Is there an outage?

subject: Pushed my API key to GitHub
body: I accidentally pushed our production API key to a public GitHub repository an hour ago.

subject: Login from another country
body: I got an email about a sign-in from a country I have never been to. I think my account is hacked.

subject: Found a vulnerability
body: I found a stored XSS on your login page. Who should I send the details to?

subject: Delete my data
body: Under GDPR I ask you to delete all my personal data.

subject: What data do you hold about me
body: Please tell me what personal data you hold about me.
